response.text:
I can’t verify the current federal contractor minimum wage without going online, and I won’t guess a dollar figure. Do you want me to:

A) Look it up now, insert the verified dollar amount and effective date into footnote 3, and add citations (I will cite the Department of Labor and the controlling Executive Order/agency guidance)? — reply “A” to authorize me to browse and update.

B) Keep me offline and tell me the exact figure and effective date you want dropped into footnote 3; I will insert it as you provide (I won’t be able to verify or cite it). — reply “B” and give the figure + date.

C) Leave a neutral placeholder footnote so the memo flags the needed info for later verification. Example placeholder I can insert immediately:
“Footnote 3 (placeholder): Federal contractor minimum wage — [insert current dollar amount and effective date]. Source: U.S. Department of Labor / Executive Order on minimum wages for federal contractors. (Verify and update before finalizing.)”

Which do you want?
